configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: Default toolchain on Windows. Benchmarks build with /O2 pinned in bench/CMakeLists.txt.

configurePresets.name: clang-cl
configurePresets.description: Separate compiler, same ABI as MSVC. Used to compare code generation between the two.

configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.description: LLVM clang driver. Needs the llvm-mingw or a GNU-like environment on Windows.

configurePresets.name: gcc
configurePresets.description: GCC, used on Linux and on the Raspberry Pi boards.

configurePresets.name: gcc-pi
configurePresets.description: Same as gcc, kept separate so that Pi runs are recorded under their own preset name. Expect a much smaller workload: the benchmark sizes itself from RAM and cache.

configurePresets.name: tests-only
configurePresets.description: The configuration used for ordinary development and for the test suite.
